Both borderline and unusable are recorded as failing QC.
Measured for the {batch} plate: curve coefficient of determination 0.9938, falling within the allowed retest interval under the new criteria; three-level recoveries 97.6%/99.1%/96.3%, all passing; parallel sample CVs 2.9%/3.4%/4.1%; blank signal 0; internal standard drift 5.1%. Under the old criteria, the curve for this plate passed; under the new criteria, it is a single out-of-bounds item recorded as borderline and requires rerunning the original plate once; instrument and sample status are normal, so no investigation is initiated.
Also: I have approved the preventive maintenance request for the {device} on {date}; it is unrelated to this recheck.
